findings.detail: Description of "append_relay" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_relays · Private data: wait_for_relay, append_relay, get_relay, exists, list_relays, list_replies · Public sink: append_relay.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_relays · Private data: wait_for_relay, append_relay, get_relay, exists, list_relays, list_replies · Public sink: append_relay

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
